alt: A sorted array with a left pointer and a right pointer. When the two pointed-at values sum to at most K, every position between left and right also pairs with left at or under K, since the array is sorted, so that whole range is counted at once and left moves in. Otherwise right moves in without counting anything.

steps.caption: left starts at index 0 (1), right starts at index 4 (5). K is 6. count starts at 0.
arr[0] + arr[4] = 6, at most K. Every partner between left and right also sums to at most K with arr[0], since the array is sorted: that is 4 more pairs. count becomes 4. left moves right.
arr[1] + arr[4] = 7, over K. arr[4] cannot pair with anything smaller and still fit. right moves left.
arr[1] + arr[3] = 6, at most K. Every partner between left and right also sums to at most K with arr[1], since the array is sorted: that is 2 more pairs. count becomes 6. left moves right.
arr[2] + arr[3] = 7, over K. arr[3] cannot pair with anything smaller and still fit. right moves left.
left and right meet or cross. The final count of pairs summing to at most 6 is 6.

left and right meet or cross. The final count of pairs summing to at most 1 is 0.
